title: Nachuma ben Efkashyon (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in a baraita in Yoma 28b, in a dispute of R. Yishmael and R. Akiva with Nachuma ben Efkashyon and Matya ben Shmuel. Hyman reports the reading R. Chanina ben Efkashyon in Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: The notice lists the four disputants and preserves the alternative Chanina reading. No additional dispute details are supplied.
The consulted Yoma passage gives separate formulations by Yishmael, Akiva, Nechuma and Mattia, followed by Yehudah ben Beteira. The Chanina variant in Dikdukei Soferim is reported by Hyman.
